name: XCC_TREE_VERSIONS
description: This table contains the tree versions that are extracted into budgetary control. It also contains the status of the extraction, the last time the extraction was successful, and the last time the extraction was attempted.

columns.name: TREE_STRUCTURE_CODE
columns.description: Primary key for tree related other essential information.

columns.name: TREE_CODE
columns.description: Primary key for tree related other essential information.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Primary key for the tree version of the flexfield segment tree.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the tree version extraction.

columns.name: LAST_EXTRACT_SUCCESS_TIME
columns.description: The last date and time the tree version was successfully extracted.

columns.name: LAST_EXTRACT_ATTEMPT_TIME
columns.description: The last date and time the tree version was attempted to be extracted.

columns.name: LAST_TREE_NODES_UPDATE_TIME
columns.description: Last date and time the tree nodes were updated by the Manage Trees and Tree Versions task when the tree version was copied or refreshed into budgetary control.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
